name: Manzanka Zero
source: Manzanka Zero is a student of Yusei Junior High School's class 2-1. He appears aloof and spaced out, and his muscular build makes him hard to approach, but he is actually kind and mature. He is surprisingly close with Rokuro, often being with him.
